# @amykit/plugin-agent-browser

Drives a web page through agent-browser: open, snapshot, act on refs, diff, and a UI check that settles on structure, then pixels, then an agent.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy).

Use it when a proof has to look at a web page. It adds browser operations a prove scenario can call: open a URL, read the accessibility tree, click or type on a ref, and compare the page with a baseline. Its UI check settles on structure and pixels first and asks the mounted agent only when those disagree, so mount agent-relay beside it for that last step. It needs the agent-browser CLI on the machine.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | _none_ |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | `browser.act`, `browser.diff-screenshot`, `browser.diff-snapshot`, `browser.open`, `browser.snapshot`, `browser.ui-check` |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-agent-browser
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-agent-browser"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-agent-browser":
    binary: "agent-browser"
    session: "amy"
    timeoutMs: 60000
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `binary` | `string` | no | `agent-browser` | the agent-browser command, or a path to it |
| `session` | `string` | no | `amy` | the agent-browser session every operation drives, so steps of one scenario share one browser |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | no | `60000` | how long one agent-browser command may run |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
